CellToMaterialFile.documentation: Input file that maps each cell to a material ID

OrientationFile.documentation: Input file that provides orientation matrices for each cell

a_kineticParam.documentation: Kinetic parameter a in the kinetic equation

m_kineticParam.documentation: Kinetic parameter m in the kinetic equation

C11_0.documentation: Elasticity tensor component C11 at reference temperature

C11_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for elasticity tensor component C11

C12_0.documentation: Elasticity tensor component C12 at reference temperature

C12_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for elasticity tensor component C12

C13_0.documentation: Elasticity tensor component C13 at reference temperature

C13_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for elasticity tensor component C13

C33_0.documentation: Elasticity tensor component C33 at reference temperature

C33_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for elasticity tensor component C33

C44_0.documentation: Elasticity tensor component C44 at reference temperature

C44_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for elasticity tensor component C44

alpha11_0.documentation: Basal-plane CTE alpha_a. Read from the Steward et al. curve at 1800-2000 K, where it plateaus at ~1.2e-6. FROM A FIGURE, not from source data.

alpha11_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for thermal expansion coefficient at a-axis direction

alpha33_0.documentation: c-axis CTE alpha_c. Read from the Steward et al. curve at 1800-2000 K (~32e-6). The previous 27e-6 corresponded to ~600 K on that same curve. FROM A FIGURE, not from source data.

alpha33_functionOfTemperature.documentation: Function of temperature for thermal expansion coefficient at c-axis direction

InitialGlobalRefinements.documentation: Uniform refinements applied once after reading the mesh: 0->1, 1->8, 2->64 elements per grain.

LengthOfTheBody.documentation: Length of the body in meters

FinalTemperature.documentation: Temperature at the end of cooling process

OutputFrequency.documentation: Frequency of output (in terms of number of steps)

WriteFullStressTensor.documentation: Also write the complete stress tensor in BOTH frames (five remaining local components plus all six global). Off by default; on for post-hoc analysis.

WriteFullStrainTensor.documentation: Also write the complete TOTAL strain tensor in both frames.

DamageIncrementRelativeTolerance.documentation: Relative tolerance for damage increment in in displacement-damage iteration

DisplacementIncrementRelativeTolerance.documentation: Relative tolerance for displacement increment in in displacement-damage iteration

ForceEqulibriumRelativeTolerance.documentation: Relative tolerance for force equilibrium residiual in displacement-damage iteration

KineticAlgebraicSolverTolerance.documentation: Relative tolerance of iterative algebraic solver for kinetic equation

MaxNumberOfIterations.documentation: Maximum number of iterations for displacement-damage iteration

LinearSolverTolerance.documentation: Relative tolerance (vs |rhs|) for the CG linear solve. Set tight here (not the 1e-6 production default) so the algebraic stress-damage consistency check in process_solution measures the COUPLING rather than the linear solver -- at 1e-6 it bottomed out at ~1.4e-3*StressThreshold; at 1e-12 it reaches ~2e-11*StressThreshold, i.e. round-off.

MaxLinearSolverIterations.documentation: Iteration cap for the CG linear solve.

DamageWarningThreshold.documentation: Warn once when max damage exceeds this.

UseWorkStream.documentation: Assemble and predict damage via WorkStream::run (multi-threaded). false selects the reference single-threaded loops, kept for A/B correctness and timing comparison.

NumberOfThreads.documentation: Thread cap for WorkStream. 0 = all available cores.

Type.documentation: zeroDisplacement | freeSurface | periodic. Start with zeroDisplacement to exercise the grain machinery, then freeSurface for a real <sigma>=0 free-cooling state. periodic is not implemented yet.

OrientationSeed.documentation: Seed for per-grain random c-axis orientations. RECORD THIS with any result.

UniformOrientation.documentation: Smoke test: all grains identically oriented.

GrainsPerSide.documentation: Grains along each cube edge; GrainsPerSide^3 grains total. Grain identity comes from the cell centroid, so refinement adds elements per grain without changing the grain count.
